title: OSM coverage gate for the vulnerability layer
threshold_rationale: Set to the building count of the Korean reference site, so the bar is 'at least as well mapped as the site this layer was built on' rather than an invented number.

paradise_ca_2018.why: A documented evacuation failure: 86 deaths; two of the three escape routes were closed by fire leaving one; 17 burnovers were identified, 12 of them on major evacuation roadways.
sources: Burnover events identified during the 2018 Camp Fire (nwfirescience.org)

mati_gr_2018.why: Coastal settlement; residents trapped between fire and sea.
sources: not verified in this session — see report

pedrogao_pt_2017.why: Deaths concentrated on a road during escape.
sources: not verified in this session — see report
